deadlines.notes: The UTS page lists 30 November (outside Australia) and 15 January (in Australia) for the Autumn session without printing a year; for the Autumn 2027 intake these fall on 30 Nov 2026 and 15 Jan 2027. Spring (July) closes 30 April (outside Australia).

english_policy.waiver_notes: No test is needed if you hold an assessable qualification (secondary or tertiary) undertaken in English in a listed country (incl. UK, USA, Canada, Ireland, Singapore, Australia, NZ, South Africa), or have completed at least one year of full-time secondary/post-secondary study taught in English at a recognised institution (with a letter from the institution), or hold UTS College AE5, an IB English A subject (if the Diploma was not taught in English), HKDSE English level 4+, or Cambridge C2 Proficiency 176/169. Otherwise a recognised test taken within two years.

english.notes: IELTS Academic (online and One Skill Retake also listed): 6.5 overall, 6.0 writing. Minimum for most undergraduate coursework courses; Computing Science, Economics and Mechanical Engineering use it.
Old 0-120 scale (internet-based and Home Edition): 79 overall, 21 writing.
New 1-6 scale (internet-based and Home Edition): 4 overall, 4.5 writing.
C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency: 176 overall, 169 writing.

tier_notes.general: QS World University Rankings 2027: world rank 87, 9th of the Australian universities in the table (A = ranks 6-15 on the national scale; a national scale, so not comparable with US tiers).
